name: manual_6740f3
claim: CodeQL recognizes a path-injection sanitizer only in the exact shape of its own example: normpath(join(base, name)) followed by a lone startswith(base + os.sep) check that raises. Do not combine it with alternatives such as 'or full_path == base'; reject the root case separately. A guard CodeQL cannot see turns every downstream file read or write into a new alert whenever those lines change.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: CodeQL py/path-injection kept flagging reads and writes in lan_peer_files.py although every path came from a normpath + startswith guard. The guard was written as 'full_path == base or full_path.startswith(base + os.sep)'. Replacing it with the single startswith check cleared the alerts on the next CodeQL run with no behaviour change (the filename allowlist already rejected names that resolve to the root).
